list.s:
SHARKS · SUNKEN GOLD · GEMS
55 METRES UNDER THE HUDSON
panels: A 48 m pirate ship, broken in two, her black flag still on the mast.
Swim INSIDE: the stern cabin and a hold full of barrels.
SEVEN chests of old coins and gems, full again every day.
FOUR sharks on guard. They bite!
Buy a SCUBA SET at FISHING & SCUBA and WEAR it from your pack. The tank holds 5 minutes of air and fills again, free, whenever you are out of the water.
Add GOGGLES and a HEADLIGHT. It is dark down there.
Step off the quay. Hold SPACE to go down, SHIFT to come up.
About 25 seconds down: the ship. Double-click a chest.
FISHING & SCUBA, on the Hudson row. The wreck lies on the deepest bed of the Hudson, 55 m down.

list.s: 17 kinds. The Hudson and the lake. I buy what you land.
panels: Eleven kinds in the Hudson: white perch, tomcod, eel, blue crab, catfish, shad, flounder, bluefish, striped bass, and the Atlantic sturgeon, 40 kg of him.
Six more in the park lake, up to the northern pike. Day, dusk and night each bring different fish.
Now and then the hook brings up a boot, a tin can, a message in a bottle or a sunken chest.
THE OLD CATFISH lies under the pier between 2 and 4 in the morning. Cut bait. Once a day.
Hold SPACE for power, let go to cast. B changes bait.
The float dips: SPACE, and quick.
Hold SPACE to reel. Ease off when it says EASE. Pull A or D against a run.
Take it off the hook. X or ESC when you are done.
The long pier at the foot of the way through to the Hudson. Tackle at FISHING & SCUBA. Rowboats at the foot of the pier.

list.k: THE PET SHOPS OF MARKET ST
panels: DOGS & CATS: 140 kinds of dog, 59 of cat, and rabbits.
LIZARDS & DRAGONS: ten dinosaurs with a T. REX, seven dragons and BIG LIZ.
THE BIRD SHOP and THE BUTTERFLY SHOP.
THE BARN in Central Park: horses, cows, pigs, an elephant, a giraffe, a lion.
THE AQUARIUM: 52 fish and sea animals for the tank in your apartment. A shark. A dolphin. A plesiosaur.
Every one of them is pet-sized.
Go into a shop. Double-click a cage, or THE ADOPTION BOOK.
Pick the kind, the colours and the shape.
ESC, then PETS: feed it, take it out, choose where it rides. Head, shoulder, flying or walking.
A fed, loyal pet finds you dollars.
Four shops side by side on Market St, between the bar and the bodega. THE BARN is in Central Park. THE AQUARIUM is on the Hudson row.

list.s: 25 butterflies · 13 birds · a journal to fill
panels: Twenty-five butterflies fly the park, twelve common and thirteen rare, from the Monarch to the Apollo and the Homerus Swallowtail. A rare one is worth $40 to $250.
Thirteen birds, from the house sparrow to the red-tailed hawk. A first sighting pays: $40 for the oriole, $60 for the scarlet tanager, $80 for the hawk.
The WILDLIFE page of your journal: crow, great horned owl, mallard, honeybee, bumblebee. A full page pays $50.
Hold the BUTTERFLY NET and double-click a butterfly. You carry 5; jars hold 20, 50 or 100.
IDENTIFY it in your pack, then sell it or RELEASE it.
Double-click a bird: WATCH, TAME with birdseed, or CATCH with a bird net and a cage.
Scatter seed or hang a FEEDER, and stand still.
Hold BINOCULARS, click to raise them. The wheel focuses.
Double-click a creature and keep still 5 seconds to log it.
All of Central Park. THE BUTTERFLY STALL and THE BIRD STALL stand on the park wall, west of the gate.

list.s: Fourteen power mushrooms. Eighteen wild ones.
panels: FLIGHT: five minutes in the air, up through the clouds, cape on.
SHRINK: two-fifths your size. GROW: twice your size.
JUMP: two and a half times as high.
And NIGHT VISION, INVISIBILITY, STRENGTH, SPEED, KEEN EYE, HEALING, CURE POISON, LUCK and FIREPROOF.
Wild in the park: 18 kinds, MEADOW BUTTON to LION'S MANE. Ink cap and black trumpet after rain, oyster at dawn, GHOST CAP by night, deep in the park. RED CAP, FLY AGARIC and MOONGLOW are poison.
Buy a FLIGHT MUSHROOM at THE MUSHROOM STALL.
W A S D to fly. SPACE up, SHIFT down.
To pick a wild one, double-click it on a park lawn.
THE MUSHROOM STALL, on the park wall east of the gate. Wild ones grow on the lawns of Central Park.

list.s: Keep bees. Six honeys. One only by moonlight.
panels: The flowers within eight tiles of the hive decide the honey: wildflower, clover, sunflower, lavender or rose.
MOON HONEY is made only at night, deep in the park, and is worth ten times wildflower.
A frame fills every half hour, up to four times faster among flowers. Ten frames to a hive, three hives to a keeper.
Buy a BEEHIVE, a SMOKER, a VEIL and EMPTY JARS.
Stand on a park lawn where flowers grow thick. In your pack press SET IT HERE.
Leave it. The hive fills in real time.
Come back. The smoker quiets the bees; the veil keeps stings off.
Double-click the hive and TAKE HONEY.
LIFT IT to move the hive.
THE BEEKEEPER'S STALL, on the park wall west of the gate. The Village Gardener keeps it and buys your honey and wax.
Twenty paintings people call life-changing in one room under a skylight, hung close, two high, the way the old salons hung them.
The Night Watch. The Starry Night. The Raft of the Medusa. Las Meninas. The Garden of Earthly Delights. Each has its own guided tour.
Double-click any painting to see it full screen at full resolution, then press GUIDED TOUR.
THE FLOOR PLAN by the door lists every painting.
Double-click a painting to look closely.
Press GUIDED TOUR: every painting has one.
Three dials and a star chart, new each night. The clues are on the cornerstone, on the founder's statue, in a note at the bookstore and on the sky poster by the door.
THE ART MUSEUM, at the east end of Market St.
Sixteen cases of forty: 640 real books, the most read of all time and a case for each skill, from mycology to swordsmanship.
Borrow five at a time and read them anywhere from your pack.
Eight real paintings hang on the café walls: Manet, Seurat, Caillebotte, Degas, Corot, Van Gogh. Each has its own tour.
At home, YOUR BOOKSHELF holds 70 more.
Five tables, 37 games, one to four players: chess, checkers, go, shogi, xiangqi, backgammon, mancala, dominoes, hearts, spades, bridge, cribbage, blackjack, klondike and more.
Click an empty seat to seat the computer, or INVITE A PLAYER.
Double-click a case, click a spine, BORROW IT.
THE BOOKSTORE, at the east end of the Hudson row. The Professor keeps it.

list.s: FREE PLAY · TOP TEN · THE HOLODECK
panels: PETRI: one dish shared by the whole market
Make the top ten and enter your initials. Everyone sees the same table.
Now running ROAM: a ship among the meteors.
THE ARCADE, on Market St beside the way through to the Hudson.
Real pieces, every one credited: 183 for guitar, 330 for piano, 311 for harp, and grooves for the drums.
Your fingers land on the right strings and keys. Everyone near you sees and hears you play.
Each piece asks for a skill level, 1 to 100.
Buy an instrument at THE BODEGA.
In your pack, PLAY. It is set down before you and you sit at it.
Pick a piece from the book.
Press PLAY. CLOSE-UP shows your hands.
PUT AWAY when you are done.
Try one first: THE PARK'S GUITAR stands free on the park path, and THE BAR has a grand piano.
THE BODEGA, on Market St beside the way through to the Hudson.

list.s: A telescope and a microscope in every apartment
panels: The real sky over New York, tonight: the stars of the Yale Bright Star Catalogue, the planets, the Moon, the ISS passing over, this year's comets, the meteor showers at their real rates.
Today's Sun from NASA's Solar Dynamics Observatory, sunspots and all.
Real clouds too. If New York is overcast, so is your eyepiece.
GO TO finds a target. The clock drive keeps it in view.
Fit the solar filter before you look at the Sun.
Pond water alive with microbes. Make slides from what you carry: stones in polarised light, wings, spores, pollen, feathers. Objectives from 4x to 100x.
YOUR APARTMENT. Both instruments are already there.
From the commonest to the rarest: quartz, amethyst, geode, amber, moonstone, opal, emerald, sapphire, ruby, and the STAR METEORITE.
The seven sunken chests of the Hudson wreck: a stone in each, every day.
A sunken chest on your fishing hook.
The hawk's nest on the water tower, up your fire escape: a stone a day.
Loot in THE DUNGEON under the castle.
Sell a stone to the Rock Golem at the gem stall.
THE GEM STALL, on the park wall east of the gate.
